main_text.p: portet. Comp. ἀπήχεη sufficit: ἀπέχεη sufficiebat: ἀπεχέησθ sufficiet: ἀπέχεησε suffecit.
Aliquando etiam infectum est pro præsenti, ut ἔδει, ἔπρεπε, pro δεῖ, πρέπει. Sic horist. εἴωθε confuevit, solet: πέφυκε natura fit.
Formæ secundæ sunt: συνδέχεται accidit: ἐπιρχεται succurrit: unde ἐπῆλθε, in mentem venit, lubitum est. Sic λέγεται dicitur, fertur: λείπεται relinquitur, superest.

page.notes: Greek polytonic forms are approximate; several accents and breathings are uncertain and may differ from the print. Words with [?] were not clearly legible.
